review_kind: Fresh exact-source local review plus read-only review of supplied preflight witness

findings.title: Exact-command test reads the R3 plan rather than the reviewed R4 plan
findings.detail: test_exact_planned_command_matches_parent_environment loads reports/C2_P26_SOT_ZERO_REPLAY_ACCEPTANCE_PLAN_R3_20261104.json. It therefore does not assert the exact task, output, plan identity, or native_command of R4. The other tests cover generic preflight/source-pin contracts but do not replace this target-specific exact-command binding test.
findings.minimal_required_fix: Parameterize the test with a fixture or update its target to the exact R4 plan, then rerun the focused suite against the reviewed bytes. No source or test changes were made.

findings.title: Supplied witness is not the direct serialized output shape of the reviewed helper
findings.detail: The witness binds the exact R4 plan SHA and helper SHA and contains the four shard evidence and no-launch claims. However, the reviewed helper's REMOTE witness object at lines 243-259 emits task, review_sha256, and observed_at_epoch, while the supplied witness has no top-level task or review_sha256 and uses observed_at_utc. The helper main prints the returned JSON and, in preflight-only mode, does not write or normalize a local witness. The witness may have been transformed by an external capture/finalizer, but no transformation provenance is present in the reviewed artifacts, so this review cannot treat it as verbatim helper output.
findings.minimal_required_fix: Provide the raw captured preflight stdout or a hash-bound documented transformation that preserves the source witness fields. This finding does not assert that the reported remote measurements are false.

findings.title: Shard s2 and s3 precision pins are truncated and contradict the witness
findings.detail: The plan's collection_plans entries for shard s2 and s3 contain precision_sha256 values of 62 hexadecimal characters, while the supplied witness records the full 64-character digest 8fba9d3d90e81208ddaf86ac94bffd762ee8834b463586421b9c74e7c7a4fecc for each. The reviewed helper computes SHA-256 over each remote precision.json and asserts exact equality to entry.precision_sha256 at REMOTE lines 170-172. Therefore those plan entries cannot pass the helper's exact check against the witness-reported bytes. The preflight witness's aggregate claim that all pinned hashes matched is inconsistent with the exact R4 plan bytes.
findings.minimal_required_fix: Correct the two plan digest values and regenerate/review the plan and any witness against those exact bytes. Rerun a read-only preflight only after exact identities are re-established; no rerun was performed by this review.

focused_tests.command: uv run --offline --with pytest python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_launch_c2_policy_refresh_acceptance.py
focused_tests.interpretation: All current test cases pass, but the target-specific exact-command test is bound to R3, as described in R4-B1.
